conditionAssessments.evidence: A separately named pinned modern profile is an explicit proposal identity; the upstream repository does not identify itself as vn-tam-hop-default. Receiving schoolId records the unchanged product chart receiving the branch and is not a claim about upstream school or classical authority.

Complete utils/index.ts#getAgeIndex partitions all twelve canonical branch keys into four disjoint triads. Its starts resolve to chenEarthly, xuEarthly, weiEarthly, chouEarthly through kot and the pinned English branch locale, giving Thìn, Tuất, Mùi, Sửu respectively. Modern learn/setup section 5 and learn/horoscope corroborate this.

The minor-age loop tests kot(gender) === 'male' and adds i for male, subtracts i otherwise. For valid male/female keys and explicit product 1/-1 mapping this is precisely +1/-1. The birth-year yin/yang comparison belongs to the preceding decadal loop; it is not read by minor-age placement.
At i=0 and j=0, age.push(12*j+i+1) inserts 1 at ageIdx. No dependency on decadal first age or five-elements class enters the age array assignment.

Increasing i increases the listed age by one and shifts its palace index by one in the sex-specific direction. Increasing j adds twelve at the same palace. Complete fixIndex recursively adds/subtracts twelve until the valid integer index is 0–11. Dần-zero palace index p converts to Tí-one branch ID ((p+2)%12)+1.

The i<12 and j<10 loops enumerate each integer 1–120 exactly once. Restricting an adapter to these ages is supportable; this is not evidence of upstream throwing a range exception or of a universal astrological maximum. No beyond-120 extension is approved.

Once a canonical birth-year branch and a valid sex key are fixed, the ages sub-result depends on those values alone. Constants/locales and product chartInput map the coordinates explicitly, including Tý/Tí and Tỵ/Tị. Reproduced 24 actual existing natal charts show the reviewed branch can select a concrete palace/function. That is a lookup on the receiving chart, with no claim that its calendar, stars, natal anchors or school are equivalent to upstream.

Complete getHoroscope obtains yearly[1] from its own configured yearDivide path. FunctionalAstrolabe query separately computes lunar-year nominal age with normal/birthday handling and searches ages.includes(nominalAge). Those date semantics are excluded, and caller-supplied nominalAge must not be replaced by an inferred date-based age. In the birthday branch equality does not increment; the comparison is strictly greater lunar month/day and does not compare leap flags there.

The material is a pinned modern software/docs source. It provides no independent authentication of a classical edition, no expert review and no evidence of predictive accuracy. No original/default profile, Đại Hạn, childhood, natal formulas, fortune interpretation or public predictions are approved.

details: from is used in soul/body and five-elements/decadal computation. The ages sub-result does not use from, soulIndex, heavenlyStemOfSoul, fiveElementsClass or the completed decadals.

Full upstream getHoroscope still performs the adjacent computations before returning. This review approves a restricted projection of its ages mathematics, not an equivalent replacement of that complete function or its error behavior.

yearDivide normal/exact can alter the branch selected from a birth date. The proposed adapter intentionally consumes the trusted existing product natal branch and does not certify it matches either upstream boundary choice.
ageDivide normal/birthday, horoscopeDivide, target-date handling, leap effects, dayDivide and childhood fallback remain outside the direct-age scope.

kot returns unknown values unchanged; getAgeIndex can return -1 for an unknown branch; non-male input follows the reverse loop. These permissive upstream details do not justify accepting invalid adapter inputs. Proposed strict invalid rows are extra API requirements, not observations of upstream rejection.

independentPinVerification.supplementalConclusion: The packet omits the English branch locale used by getAgeIndex's literal starts. Independent inspection of its pinned raw bytes resolves chen/xu/wei/chou to the intended canonical keys; its index merges that locale into the English resource, and STAR_ALIASES contains none of these four literals. This closes that dependency by separate evidence without changing or claiming it is part of the original contextDigest.

independentVerification.description: Own source-data extraction and English-locale resolution; finite table compared to independent cyclic walk and the exact proposed formula for all 2880 combinations; all endpoint expected branch/palace/function/star witnesses reproduced using existing product code; all 24 full natal snapshots reproduced; product Tết and leap witnesses reproduced. No upstream runtime or proposed product minor-period adapter was executed.
